scope.description: Public local duels, explicit source recipe, real pressure costs, public commands and directional motions and genuine outcomes. Canvas and DOM observers are passive. Five additional BODY actions: Feral S1/S2/SUPER and Scar S3/SUPER. Existing source pixels, explicitly retimed Feral launcher, attached shield geometry and existing procedural projectile effects; no new standalone entity art. Historical V11/V12/V13 remain independently selectable. A genuine V14 outcome checks inherited source theatre; other presentations retain their V105 evidence. Partner composites and twelve unbound actions remain studies.
limits: Existing native BODY pages only; no new native drawing or isolated projectile sprite.
Feral launcher and hit-confirmed SUPER BODY phases use explicitly declared source retiming.
Projectile effects use existing procedural visuals. The source plasma has a separate high collision core.
Shield guard 9 ticks and edge 9 ticks follow their own source drawings. SUPER continuation needs an unguarded physical opening.
Partner composites, remaining unbound actions, durable inventory and costume work remain open.
One genuine V14 outcome and V11/V12/V13 compatibility are replayed here; unchanged V105 presentations retain their earlier exhaustive evidence.

evidenceAnalysis.method: Read only analysis of the recorded browser samples, without a new simulation or state mutation. Infer owner from the initial passive workbookMove SUPER, then count strictly decreasing consecutive opponent health values. Repeated display samples are ignored. Feral requires opening plus three bolts (4); Scar requires opening plus physical extension (2). Guard/miss require zero health drops and the browser already verifies absent confirmation/continuation/camera. Every post-opening damage drop has confirmed BODY metadata.
evidenceAnalysis.timingLimit: DOM health and Canvas metadata commit in adjacent React effects, so sampled damage may carry the previous Canvas action tick. Counts and observed health transitions are exact; engine fixed-clock tests certify phase timing.
evidenceAnalysis.damageLimit: These are effective combat damages after the retained combo/instinct rules, not the source base 280 total.

priorDriverResidualExample.cause: Actor position is intentionally rounded to 0.01 in the passive DOM witness. Projectile coordinates retain full precision. Source calibration and vertical origin tolerance were unchanged.

driverCalibration.method: Before this run, the actual fixed-clock motion recognizer was sampled read only in both facings at 0.25 ms phase offsets across a 60 Hz period. All 134 alignments recognized 236236; six directional phases plus button fit in 14 ticks. Only browser command holds were made at least one fixed tick long; the same 198 assertions and passive observation cadence were retained.

earlierRuns.cause: A 16 ms directional hold can fall entirely between 60 Hz samples and omit the first forward of 236236.
After only double-motion correction, a remaining 16 ms simple-motion button hold was not sampled; all command holds were then changed to 32 ms.

visualInspection.method: All 27 original browser PNGs were individually opened with view_image. Source selection, original BODY facings, floor contact, visible weapon/projectile directions, guard/edge poses, confirmed SUPER continuations, bounded camera, guarded/missed branches and the genuine result were inspected. Five representative original PNGs are copied portably; the full produced inventory is retained here.
visualInspection.limits: Visual review checks these delivered frames and composition, not new lore certification or independently authored entity sprites.
